name: rlm-project-assistant
description: Set up and operate the RLM (Recursive Language Models) Orchestrator for processing arbitrarily large contexts. Handles Rust builds, Ollama/LiteLLM provider configuration, WASM compilation targets, and query workflows. Use when: setting up RLM project, configuring LLM providers for RLM, running queries against large files (10MB+), troubleshooting WASM compilation errors, or analyzing conversation exports.
